notes: Anthropic-direct rates source: anthropic.com/pricing. Cursor provider rates (composer-*, and suffixed thinking/effort variants such as claude-opus-4-8-thinking-xhigh) are metered through the Cursor subscription and are approximate. The cost matcher uses exact (dot/dash-normalised) key equality, so each suffixed variant the cursor-claude profile spawns needs its own key — a base family entry will NOT match a suffixed id. Unknown model_id falls back to the `default` entry; that includes the Cursor `default` (Auto) model.
